name: databuddy
description: Cookieless web and product analytics for your agent. Ask about traffic, signups, funnels, errors, Web Vitals and replays, find out why a number changed, and add Databuddy tracking to your app.

interface.longDescription:
Databuddy is cookieless web and product analytics. Connect it and ask in plain words about traffic, top pages, referrers, campaigns, visits from AI assistants, goals, funnels, revenue, errors, Core Web Vitals and session replays.

When a number moves, Databuddy's investigations check traffic, funnels, errors and replays and show the evidence for what changed, so you get a reason, not just a chart.

You can also manage goals, funnels, annotations, feature flags and short links. Every change shows a preview first and waits for your yes. At sign-in you choose the organization, websites and permissions; changes stay off until you allow them.

The plugin also includes a skill for adding Databuddy tracking, custom events and feature flags to your app.
capabilities: Answer questions about traffic, pages, referrers, campaigns and AI assistant visits
Measure goals, funnels and signup conversions
Explain why a metric changed using saved investigations and evidence
Find errors, slow pages and Core Web Vitals regressions
Manage goals, funnels, annotations, feature flags and short links with a preview first
Add Databuddy tracking and custom events to an app
defaultPrompt: Why did signups drop last week? Check the funnel, errors and replays.
Which pages do visitors from ChatGPT and other AI assistants land on?
What were my top pages and traffic sources last month, compared with the month before?
